import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel
import json

BASE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1"
ADAPTER_PATH = "/root/tbab_multi_turn/checkpoints/c4_full_tbab_seed42"

base_model.resize_token_embeddings(32004)

# 记录 resize 后的随机初始化值（merge 前）
pre_merge_embed = base_model.model.embed_tokens.weight[32000:32004].clone()
pre_merge_lmhead = base_model.lm_head.weight[32000:32004].clone()
print(f"Pre-merge embed norms: {pre_merge_embed.norm(dim=1)}")
print(f"Pre-merge lm_head norms: {pre_merge_lmhead.norm(dim=1)}")

# 加载 adapter

# 读取 adapter 中的 bridge token 权重
print("\n=== Step 2: Read adapter bridge token weights ===")
# 检查 adapter 是否有 embed_tokens/lm_head 的训练权重
for name, param in peft_model.named_parameters():
    if any(bid_str in name for bid_str in ['embed_tokens', 'lm_head']):
        print(f"  {name}: shape={param.shape}, requires_grad={param.requires_grad}")

# 获取 adapter 状态下的 bridge token 权重
adapter_embed = peft_model.model.model.embed_tokens.weight[32000:32004].clone()
adapter_lmhead = peft_model.model.lm_head.weight[32000:32004].clone()
print(f"Adapter embed norms: {adapter_embed.norm(dim=1)}")
print(f"Adapter lm_head norms: {adapter_lmhead.norm(dim=1)}")

# 检查 adapter 权重是否与随机初始化不同（即训练是否改变了它们）

lmhead_changed = not torch.allclose(pre_merge_lmhead, adapter_lmhead, atol=1e-3)
print(f"\nEmbed changed from random init: {embed_changed}")
print(f"LM_head changed from random init: {lmhead_changed}")

print("\n=== Step 3: merge_and_unload() ===")
merged_model = peft_model.merge_and_unload()

# 读取 merge 后的权重
merged_embed = merged_model.model.embed_tokens.weight[32000:32004].clone()
merged_lmhead = merged_model.lm_head.weight[32000:32004].clone()
print(f"Merged embed norms: {merged_embed.norm(dim=1)}")
print(f"Merged lm_head norms: {merged_lmhead.norm(dim=1)}")

print("\n=== Step 4: Compare ===")

lmhead_match = torch.allclose(adapter_lmhead, merged_lmhead, atol=1e-5)
print(f"Embed match (adapter vs merged): {embed_match}")
print(f"LM_head match (adapter vs merged): {lmhead_match}")

lmhead_still_random = torch.allclose(pre_merge_lmhead, merged_lmhead, atol=1e-3)
